access.session.text: start issues a four-digit session_number; end ends the shared access cycle

executor.session.text: attach-only; session_number is mandatory and may have leading zeros; attachment binds the local work cycle

coordinator.session.text: attach-only; session_number is mandatory and may have leading zeros; attachment binds the local work cycle

executor.task_list.text: read is summary-only, excludes archived tasks; state=done includes done tasks; next_cursor continues pagination

coordinator.task_list.text: read is summary-only, excludes archived tasks; state=done includes done tasks; next_cursor continues pagination

*.message.text: send requires non-null text; message_hash must be absent or null. ack requires non-null message_hash; text must be absent or null. reply requires both text and message_hash non-null. read/history/recipients require both text and message_hash absent or null; explicit null is accepted (non-null values forbidden).
Mesh scope defaults to local; scope=fleet is accepted as transport input but returns feature_disabled; recipients are resolved in the local attachment and messages expire after 24 hours.

For send/reply, nullable mode defaults to notify; mode=alert sets alert and require_reply. Either alert=true or require_reply=true forces final mode=alert even when mode=notify or mode=ack. mode=ack is a delivery mode, distinct from action=ack.
*.message.anchor: normalized_mode = mode or ("alert" if alert or require_reply else "notify")

*.message.text: namespace and task_id must be both absent/null or both present/non-null; otherwise invalid_task_target. For send, missing/null target means local broadcast (which can fail no_active_recipients); reply inherits target from the parent and ignores supplied target.

executor.task_comment.text: comment (default action) requires non-null comment_text and rejects checkpoint. checkpoint requires non-null checkpoint and rejects comment_text. Unknown fields including expected_revision are forbidden; checkpoint does not accept expected_revision.

executor.task_claim.text: claim requires claim_intent as a non-null string(1..160); release forbids claim_intent. claim forbids release_reason. Action-specific allowed fields and extra_forbidden rules derive from TaskClaimRequest and TaskReleaseRequest.
release_reason is optional even when an existing live claim is released; when omitted, runtime uses released_by_owner; idempotent not-claimed release also needs no reason.

coordinator.task_manage.text: create requires non-null isolation_hint. update requires non-null expected_revision (minimum 1) and task_id. For every action the accepted field whitelist, required fields and extra_forbidden policy are compiled from _TASK_MANAGE_MODELS, not from the permissive union.

checkpoint requires non-null checkpoint; state requires non-null state; review requires non-null dimensions (1..3 distinct A/C/R) and verdict; comment requires non-null comment_text; relate/unrelate require non-null relation_kind and related_task_id.
archive requires at least one non-null archive_note or note; either is sufficient. create with state=done requires non-null result.

The handler serializes with exclude_none=True and exclude_unset=True; update description:null is omitted/no change, while tags:[] explicitly replaces the stored list with an empty list. Other explicit non-null collection values replace, not append.

relation_kind is an open string(1..64), not an enum. For relation_kind=review_of on relate: source lane must be review; parent candidate_ref must be nonempty; no different review_of parent; source candidate_ref if set must match parent, otherwise it is bound from parent. Possible errors review_task_required, missing_parent_candidate, ambiguous_review_parent, candidate_conflict.
Canonical update/mutation state transitions and task revision checks remain enforced by the existing server; an omitted optional field may mean no mutation.
request_id on create is the stable operation identity; reuse only on transport retries of the same create; independent creates need a fresh request_id.
coordinator.task_manage.anchor: Create operation identity. Reuse only on transport retries

executor.command_run.text: a command run executes a shell command in the current managed work session; no implicit idempotency guarantee

coordinator.task_get.text: detail chooses snapshot, detail or history; history_kind and cursor apply to history

executor.task_state.text: Any admitted agent may set a valid task state irrespective of another agent's live claim/ownership; task existence and admission remain required; do not imply own claim is needed.
